$comment: Reference copy of the Font Awesome 4.1.0 glyph outlines that src/shared/ui/icon.ts
inlines, extracted from the SVG webfont this repository vendored until version 2.0
dropped it (Font Awesome 4.1.0 by Dave Gandy, https://fontawesome.com). Both paths
below are written as `git show` arguments against the legacy-1.x tag, the last revision
before the modernization, where that whole directory sits unchanged.
and this file is the lasting record of what the artwork is and where it came from;
src/shared/ui/icon.test.ts asserts that ICONS still matches it exactly, which is what stops
an icon being swapped, truncated or silently redrawn.
Each `codepoint` is the one the legacy `fa-*` class resolved to in
horiz-adv-x in font units and `path` is its outline `d`, both copied verbatim and both
in the font's y-up coordinate space.
